notes.title: Alpha V0.1.37
notes.content:
Alpha V0.1.37

Building
[list]
[*] Building System Fixes
[*] Added the Fence, FenceDoor, FenceShort to the 3rd tab of the building menu
[*] Moved Campfire to the 4th
[*] Fixed PlantBed, FarmTile pivot points and improved building collision checks
[*] Added Scarecrow to the 6th tab also improved it (now can be damaged by the player, displays the HealthBar, FloatingText + Flash Damage material)
[*] Other fixes like BeesNiagara effect spawned when the building object is actually built (similar for Cooking Station no audio+niagara until built)
[/list]

Performance
[list]
[*] Fixed Locked FPS bug (No longer stays in PauseMenu framerate limit when entering the game from Continue, NewGame or Load).
[*] 
[/list]
Inventory
[list]
[*] Items are no longer duplicated when re-equipping (i.e. arrows). Arrows are now removed correctly from the Inventory when shoot. Stackable Items are now correctly removed from the Inventory (when they are already equipped, i.e. arrows ->  10-4=6 available)
[*] Item Equipment Slots are now updated correctly when moving an item to other equipment slot (i.e. consumables).
[/list]

Consumables
[list]
[*] Changes to the Consumable Bar - now shows the LB input that needs to be pressed + displays the menu all the time for better tracking. Additionally empty slots are 0.5 opacity.
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Changes to Quest UI
[*] Fixed Squished Icons for Tutorial Prompts
[/list]

Dialogue
[list]
[*] Fixed Hazel dialogue when returning after getting glider
[/list]
